title: Asian Games 2026 set for liftoff but will everyone have a bed?

blocks.text: The Asian Games 2026 open in Japan on Saturday with 2028 Olympics places up for grabs, fast-rising talents in world sports in action and thousands of athletes staying on a cruise ship in typhoon season. More than 17,000 competitors and officials are expected at the continent’s biggest sporting spectacular, which takes place in Nagoya and the wider Aichi prefecture until October 4. The number of participants — more than the Olympics — has been a sore point for stretched-to-the-limit organizers, who initially expected 15,000 and have had to scramble to find accommodation for the rest.
